description: Dept. of Local Government- Eastern Province Summon Meeting of Under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 22 of 2012
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with summoning a meeting to fill a vacancy for the Vice Chairman position in a local authority under the Local Authorities Elections legislation. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including scheduling a meeting for election purposes, which falls squarely under Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
